versions.changelog:
v1.0.1 — Republication. Contenu strictement identique a la 1.0.0 (SHA-256 verifie, aucun octet modifie).

Motif: la 1.0.0 n'etait jamais entree dans l'index de recherche du registre. Sa propre requete-slug exacte renvoyait 0 resultat, et elle etait absente du listing 'newest' alors que celui-ci remontait 22h avant sa publication.

1.0.0 — Initial release.

Provision a Linux VM that drives a browser for an agent, and survive the traps: Chromium snap blocked by AppArmor, /dev/shm at 64 MB, headed-under-Xvfb working where headless fails, and the egress cost tiers nobody mentions until the bill.

Stops at any bot defence: when a platform control fires, the run ends and a human decides. Nothing here is designed to get past one.
